Another sharp pain rocked his arm as his pinkie plopped into the side of the jar, then on his bloodied boxers, and finally bounced on the ground below. He tried to catch it, but his delayed reaction was not even close; his senses were growing dull while a lightheaded feeling crept on.
e3720f94d376.t: Harry merasa darah hangat terus berdenyut dari tiga tunggul di tangan kanannya, menghantar gelombang darah dengan setiap degupan jantung yang akan memenuhi hampir segelas kecil dengan setiap denyutan. Sensasi hangat bercampur kebas yang pelik itu terasa seperti jari-jarinya masih ada dan dia malah boleh menggerakkannya, tetapi itu bukan apa yang dilihat matanya. Satu lagi sakit tajam menggegarkan lengannya ketika jari kelingkingnya jatuh ke tepi balang, kemudian ke atas seluar boxernya yang berdarah, dan akhirnya melantun ke lantai di bawah. Dia cuba menangkapnya, tetapi reaksinya yang lambat langsung tidak hampir; derianya menjadi tumpul sementara rasa pening merayap masuk.

e4d02df30cdd.en: Looking at the magical spectacle happening on Eori’s hand and forearms, Harry instead squinted his eyes around the room, looking for bluish nari gel*.* “Can—can I ask why—you’re not using Nari—Refresher?” His was still slurry as it grew softer and quieter, developing a lisp of sorts as his eyes grew as lifeless as before he drank the black honey.
e4d02df30cdd.t: Memandang pertunjukan ajaib yang berlaku pada tangan dan lengan bawah Eori, Harry sebaliknya mengecilkan matanya di sekeliling bilik, mencari nari gel kebiruan*.* “Boleh—boleh saya tanya kenapa—awak tak guna Nari—Refresher?” Suaranya masih pelat sementara ia menjadi lebih lembut dan perlahan, menjadi seakan-akan pelat lidah sementara matanya menjadi tidak bermaya seperti sebelum dia minum madu hitam.

e56e61715726.en: With a girly laugh, Eori spoke in his ear, “You’re from nowhere! Nobody knows you! And you have nobody!” She wet her lips while her hand rubbed against his back, going down to give his flat butt a squish. “Which means nobody is going to bother us! You’re all mine to have fun with!”
e56e61715726.t: Dengan ketawa keperempuanan, Eori bercakap di telinga Harry, “Kau dari mana-mana pun tak! Tak ada sesiapa kenal kau! Dan kau tak ada sesiapa!” Dia membasahkan bibirnya sementara tangannya menggosok belakang Harry, turun untuk meramas punggungnya yang leper. “Maknanya tak ada sesiapa akan ganggu kita! Kau semua aku punya untuk berseronok!”

e71c746f16c7.en: “A-aren’t you going to cut my thumb?” With a slight slurring speech, Harry showed the last finger in his hand—it looked lonely, wanting to jump in the bloody pool with its buddies.
e71c746f16c7.t: “A-awak tak nak potong ibu jari saya ke?” Dengan pertuturan yang sedikit pelat, Harry menunjukkan jari terakhir di tangannya—ia kelihatan kesunyian, mahu terjun ke dalam kolam berdarah bersama kawan-kawannya.

ea7f4dd130c6.en: Growing paler by the minute, Harry tried his best to do as Eori kept asking. With each jolt of shocking stabbing pain, the lightheaded feeling grew intense, making even sitting up straight hard. With only his thumbs remaining, he couldn’t even pick up the bloodied jar of fingers still resting between his thighs.
ea7f4dd130c6.t: Semakin pucat dari minit ke minit, Harry cuba sedaya upaya untuk melakukan seperti yang terus diminta Eori. Dengan setiap sentakan sakit menusuk yang mengejutkan, rasa pening menjadi kuat, membuatkan duduk tegak pun susah. Dengan hanya ibu jarinya yang tinggal, dia tidak dapat pun mengangkat balang berdarah berisi jari yang masih terletak di antara pahanya.

eba78c8fd637.en: Harry walked towards the book, squinting his eyes, seeing that it looked ready to fall apart, with some letters missing from its title. G--iro Sund-ath Sc-entist. A d--per d--e in-- Buhr---s soul anal--is. He slowly opened the book cover, only to feel his heartbeat skip when he saw and heard the bindings tearing off.
eba78c8fd637.t: Harry berjalan ke arah buku itu, mengecilkan matanya, melihat ia kelihatan hampir hancur, dengan beberapa huruf hilang dari tajuknya. G--iro Sund-ath Sa-ntis. Sel--man l--ih d-l-m an-l-sis jiwa Buhr---s. Dia perlahan-lahan membuka kulit buku itu, hanya untuk merasa degupan jantungnya terlepas apabila dia melihat dan mendengar jilidannya terkoyak.

ed4c423edf32.en: Pure stupefaction ran through Harry’s body, realizing the would-be danger. The hairs on his skin bumped as the word dead triggered his imagination of the ghastly white fire consuming him whole, making him scream at the fire burning him, except—but the fire doesn’t burn? Harry looked back at the fireplace, where an actual red-hot fire was warming up the room. “But—it doesn’t burn, so how does it kill? May—I ask what it means to be—soul dead?”
ed4c423edf32.t: Kebingungan tulen mengalir di seluruh badan Harry, menyedari bahaya yang hampir berlaku. Bulu romanya meremang ketika perkataan mati mencetuskan imaginasinya tentang api putih menyeramkan itu menelannya sepenuhnya, membuatkannya menjerit kepada api yang membakarnya, kecuali—tapi api tu tak membakar? Harry kembali memandang perapian, di mana api merah panas yang sebenar sedang memanaskan bilik. “Tapi—ia tak membakar, jadi macam mana ia membunuh? Boleh—saya tanya apa maknanya—mati jiwa?”

ef3c297ce551.en: A bloody metallic smell oozing around Harry was now so familiar that his nose seemed to ignore it outright. Although, the pool of blood on the floor did bring him back to when he awakened in the smelly room of the Sanbi castle’s southwest tower. His memory was still vivid enough to remember the smell of the bagarisa musk stench in that room. If only I hadn’t woken up that day—but then where would I even be?
ef3c297ce551.t: Bau logam berdarah yang meleleh di sekeliling Harry kini begitu biasa sehingga hidungnya seakan-akan mengabaikannya sama sekali. Walaupun, kolam darah di lantai memang membawanya kembali ke ketika dia tersedar di bilik busuk di menara barat daya Istana Sanbi. Ingatannya masih cukup jelas untuk mengingati bau hapak musk bagarisa dalam bilik itu. Kalaulah aku tak bangun hari tu—tapi kalau macam tu aku akan berada kat mana pun?

f58ce8a20e99.en: Harry could hear the guy’s armor clacking towards the inside of the house. He felt a sensation akin to drinking a gallon of coffee, but more like half-gallon or even less than that—it seemed to be missing the je ne sais quoi aspect of I have to do something about it exactly right now, or I will drop dead. Instead, his brain seemed to be acting logical for once, telling him to go downstairs slowly, trying to avoid making too much noise with his shackles as they rustled against the wooden stairs. His breath seemed to have stopped as he tried to avoid the creaky stairs, while his feet were hypersensitive to keeping a grip to counteract the moist blood staining the steps.
f58ce8a20e99.t: Harry dapat mendengar perisai lelaki itu berdetak-detak ke arah dalam rumah. Dia merasa sensasi seperti minum segelen kopi, tetapi lebih seperti setengah gelen atau kurang daripada itu—ia seakan-akan kekurangan aspek je ne sais quoi Aku kena buat sesuatu pasal ni sekarang juga, atau aku akan mati terus. Sebaliknya, otaknya seakan-akan bertindak logik buat sekali ini, menyuruhnya turun tangga perlahan-lahan, cuba mengelak membuat terlalu banyak bunyi dengan garinya yang bergeser pada tangga kayu. Nafasnya seakan-akan berhenti sementara dia cuba mengelak tangga yang berkeriut, sementara kakinya amat sensitif untuk mengekalkan cengkaman bagi mengimbangi darah lembap yang mengotori anak tangga.

fc5ffb312ac8.en: Please, not the sword. Feeling his hands starting to tremble as he imagined the sword slicing him apart like butter, Harry tried to calm his heart as he continued to pour out the excess nari gel in waves, making sure the white flames didn’t get into the glass and that he didn’t pour out the whitish–bluish glob resting in the bottom. He then popped the cork of a test tube resting on the ground near the fireplace and carefully dumped the glob—it slid and plopped into the tube clump-like, quite close to an egg yolk. With a sizeable relieving breath as he felt his shoulder relax, he corked the test tube and put away the glass and tongs. This is still really weird! His hand hesitated at first, but then he went for it and grabbed the test tube with his bare hands. It’s not even warm! He stood up and rustled his chains as he walked over to Eori.
fc5ffb312ac8.t: Tolonglah, jangan pedang. Merasa tangannya mula menggeletar sambil dia membayangkan pedang itu menghiris dia seperti mentega, Harry cuba menenangkan jantungnya sambil dia terus menuang nari gel yang berlebihan sedikit demi sedikit, memastikan api putih tidak masuk ke dalam kaca dan dia tidak menuang keluar gumpalan keputihan–kebiruan yang terletak di dasar. Dia kemudian membuka gabus sebuah tabung uji yang terletak di lantai berhampiran perapian dan dengan berhati-hati menuang gumpalan itu—ia menggelongsor dan jatuh ke dalam tabung seperti ketulan, agak serupa dengan kuning telur. Dengan nafas lega yang besar sambil dia merasa bahunya mengendur, dia menyumbat tabung uji itu dengan gabus dan menyimpan kaca dan penyepit. Ni masih pelik gila! Tangannya teragak-agak pada mulanya, tetapi kemudian dia memberanikan diri dan mengambil tabung uji itu dengan tangan kosong. Tak suam pun! Dia berdiri dan menggemerincingkan rantainya sambil berjalan ke arah Eori.

feccb83802bc.en: Eori let out a sigh, “Fuck! We will need to cut that one again later. Show me your other hand.”
feccb83802bc.t: Eori mengeluh, “Celaka! Kita kena potong yang tu lagi nanti. Tunjuk tangan kau yang lagi satu.”
